description: Source code for a performance tracing target in C, specifically related to trace2 performance metrics in a Git project. Contains initialization, termination, and various event logging functions for performance data.

classes.name: struct tr2_dst
classes.description: Structure defining destination for trace2 performance data.

classes.name: struct tr2_tgt
classes.description: Structure defining trace2 target with function pointers for performance events.

classes.name: struct tr2tls_thread_ctx
classes.description: Thread-local storage context for trace2 operations.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Repository related data structure used in trace logging.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Represents a child process with associated trace2 metadata.

classes.name: struct tr2_timer_metadata
classes.description: Metadata for timers in trace2 performance metrics.

classes.name: struct tr2_timer
classes.description: Timer structure used for measuring durations in trace2.

classes.name: struct tr2_counter_metadata
classes.description: Metadata for counters in trace2 performance metrics.

classes.name: struct tr2_counter
classes.description: Counter structure used for counting occurrences in trace2.

methods.description: Terminates the performance trace, disabling the trace destination.
